description: The file defines a React component 'ShippingCalculator' that provides a user interface for calculating shipping rates based on user input (ZIP codes, weight, service level). It manages form state, simulates an API call to retrieve rates, and displays the results with animations and styling.

methods.name: ShippingCalculator
methods.description: Main React component rendering the shipping rate calculator form, managing state, handling user input, simulating rate fetching, and displaying estimated rates.
